cuda_changes: Adopted fixed dispatch; native strided inputs including input-reuse packing, observer-visible shared activation, and seven-row reuse with unchanged per-shape K-slice arithmetic. Optional caller-owned W4 partial sums and arrival counters isolate early DFlash2 context preparation; arithmetic and default scratch ownership remain unchanged. Optional direct rank-packet MHC consumer preserves canonical FP32 sum and BF16 input rounding. Optional direct TX-slot output resolves its address after the producer dependency and system-fences every final writer; W4/input-reuse arithmetic is unchanged. Qualified wide-row input reuse packs each activation once without changing the ordinary MMA/reduction; the packed-input specialization remains separate from direct TX-slot production. K=7 C1 output and paired-query projections keep their original K slices inside one CTA, eliminating global partial/counter traffic; K=1536/2048/3072 specializations retain the original accumulation and rounding order. Bound C1 forward projections parallelize independent K-block MMA products while preserving the original per-slice FMA and final fold order. Joined C1 query grids retain the proven asynchronous W4 reader and separate output ranges. Rejected direct-register readers were removed. C1 packed MHC assigns eight tails to fixed CTAs of the two-token group, keeping every chunk arrival and arithmetic operation while removing shared tail/exit tickets. The native automatic gate requires eight hidden-4096 rows, packed coefficients, an AR or packet consumer and 48 resident CTAs. Same-build controls retain dynamic tails. Real-weight bitwise checks, mixed 1/7/8/16/32/64-row replays and FP32 fallback pass; 89-boundary component intervals fall 8.1-8.8 percent. Full TP4 consumer validation is recorded separately in measurements/st_c1_mhc_static_tails_20260915. Fixed K7 C1 MHC emits its once-rounded BF16 layer input directly into the bound W4 FP8 pack. Dedicated pack-writing template instantiations and occupancy entries preserve ordinary consumers. Shared completed values feed warp-local 128-column packing. All 90 real coefficient sets pass bitwise output/pack checks with changing TP4 packets; repeated distinct-coefficient packet chains fall 19.1-19.4 percent. Whole-engine adoption requires the separate matched TP4 consumer record in measurements/st_fixed_k_cost_20260917.
